verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I do love You, I do love You, I do love You
You know that I love You, Jesus

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I pay my vows right here, right now
No matter what comes my way

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
For every season, there's a reason and a purpose under heaven
This I know, this I know

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
A time to laugh and a time to cry
A time to live and a time to die
A time to speak, and a time for silence
A time to gain and a time to lose
A time to mourn and a time to laugh
A time for peace, and a time for war

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Through every season of the soul
Through every season of Your love
Through every season in this life
I want You to know
